# children present at journey category
```{python echo=FALSE}
# Function to classify journeys
def classify_journey(dT):
    
    dT["TripHasChild"] = (dT["PartyNumu10"] > 0) 

    # Identify journeys with any children present
    journey_with_children = dT.groupby("JourneyId")["TripHasChild"].agg(
        lambda x: 1 if x.all() else 2 if x.any() else 3
    ).rename("JourneyWithChildren")

    # Assign the column directly instead of merging
    dT  = dT .drop(columns=["JourneyWithChildren"], errors="ignore")
    dT = dT.merge(journey_with_children, on="JourneyId", how="left")

    # Create a new column indicating the presence of specific child age groups
    def child_presence(row):
        if row["PartyNumu10"] > 0 and row["PartyNum1017"] > 0:
            return "Both 0–9 and 10–17"
        elif row["PartyNumu10"] > 0:
            return "0–9 only"
        elif row["PartyNum1017"] > 0:
            return "10–17 only"
        else:
            return "No children"

    dT["ChildPresence"] = dT.apply(child_presence, axis=1)

    # Create dummy variables
    dT["ChildPresence_017"] = (dT["ChildPresence"] == "Both 0–9 and 10–17").astype(int)
    dT["ChildPresence_09"] = (dT["ChildPresence"] == "0–9 only").astype(int)
    dT["ChildPresence_1017"] = (dT["ChildPresence"] == "10–17 only").astype(int)

    dT = dT[dT["AgeSimple"] <= 85]
    return dT

# Apply classification
dT = classify_journey(dT)
```

```{python echo=TRUE}
age_journey_summary = journey_counts.groupby("RespAgeSimple")["NumJourneys"].sum().reset_index()

# Step 3: Ensure RespAgeSimple is a categorical variable with correct order
sorted_ages = sorted(age_journey_summary["RespAgeSimple"].dropna().unique())

)
```

#The number of younger/older sibling in HH
```{python}
# Step 1: Recalculate number of children per age group in household
df["Num_0_9"] = df["HousehNumPers"] - df["HousehNumPers1084"]
households_with_85plus = df[df["AgeSimple"] >= 85]["SessionId"].unique()
df.loc[df["SessionId"].isin(households_with_85plus), "Num_0_9"] = np.nan

df["Num_0_17"] = df["HousehNumPers"] - df["HousehNumAdults"]
df["Num_10_17"] = df["Num_0_17"] - df["Num_0_9"]
df.loc[df["Num_10_17"] < 0, "Num_10_17"] = np.nan
df = df.dropna(subset=["Num_10_17"])

# Step 2: Get one row per household
household_df = df.drop_duplicates("SessionId")[["SessionId", "Num_0_9", "Num_10_17"]].copy()

n09 = household_df["Num_0_9"].fillna(0)
n1017 = household_df["Num_10_17"].fillna(0)

# Step 3: Create binary indicators
household_df["ChildinHH_017"] = ((n09 > 0) & (n1017 > 0)).astype(int)
household_df["ChildinHH_09"] = ((n09 > 0) & (n1017 == 0)).astype(int)
household_df["ChildinHH_1017"] = ((n09 == 0) & (n1017 > 0)).astype(int)
household_df["ChildinHH_None"] = ((n09 == 0) & (n1017 == 0)).astype(int)

# Optional: merge back if needed
df = df.merge(
    household_df[["SessionId", "ChildinHH_017", "ChildinHH_09", "ChildinHH_1017", "ChildinHH_None"]],
    on="SessionId",
    how="left"
)

df = df[df["ChildinHH_None"] == 0]
```

#	Purpose of journey (the purpose of the longest staying time of the journey)
```{python echo=FALSE}
# Define categories for PrimTargetPurp
purpose_mapping = {
    **dict.fromkeys([11], "work"),
    **dict.fromkeys([12, 13, 14], "education"),
    **dict.fromkeys([20, 23, 31, 32, 33], "errands and shopping"),
    **dict.fromkeys([21, 22], "chauffeuring"),
    **dict.fromkeys([25, 38, 42, 43, 45, 47, 49], "leisure and social activities"),
}

# Filter first
df = df[df["PrimTargetPurp"].isin(purpose_mapping.keys())]

# Then map categories (no need for fillna anymore)
df["PrimTargetPurp_Cat"] = df["PrimTargetPurp"].map(purpose_mapping)


# Display first few rows
print(df[["PrimTargetPurp", "PrimTargetPurp_Cat"]].head(30))
```
```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

categories = df["PrimTargetPurp_Cat"].unique()

for cat in categories:
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
    subset = df[df["PrimTargetPurp_Cat"] == cat]
    
    sns.histplot(subset["TravelTimeMinutes"].dropna(), bins=30, kde=False)
    plt.title(f"Distribution of Tour Duration for each Purpose: {cat}")
    plt.xlabel("Tour Duration (minutes)")
    plt.ylabel("Count")
    plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
    plt.show()
```

# Household type (single-adult households, dual-adult households, and multi-adult households)
```{python, echo=FALSE}
# Create "HhStruct" column: Household structure categories
def categorize_hh(pos):
    if pos == 10:
        return "Single-adult household"
    elif pos in [11, 12]:
        return "Couple household"
    else:  # Includes 20 and NaN values
        return "Multi-adult household"

df["HhStruct"] = df["PosInFamily"].apply(categorize_hh)

# Display first few rows
print(df[["PosInFamily", "HhStruct"]].head(10))
```

# Journey complexity (the number of tours in a journey: single trip or trip chaining)
```{python,  echo=FALSE}
output_file = os.path.join(folder_path, "data_before_compression_1.csv")

df["RespAgeSimple"] = pd.to_numeric(df["RespAgeSimple"], errors="coerce")

# Filter to include only rows with RespAgeSimple >= 18

# Create "JourneyComplx" column using .map()
journey_complexity = df_adults.groupby("JourneyId")["TurId"].nunique().map(
    lambda x: "Trip Chaining" if x > 2 else "Simple Journey"
)

# Assign directly to avoid merging issues
df_adults["JourneyComplx"] = df_adults["JourneyId"].map(journey_complexity)

# Save the updated dataset
df_adults.to_csv(output_file, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

print(df_adults[["JourneyId", "TurId", "JourneyComplx"]].head(10))
```
